landmarks_visible_in_cited_frames.kitchen_bar_counter: bearings 390-470, backlit (that is why depth coverage collapses there)

sofa_side_2026_09_09.how_measured: Aurora930 depth map via depth.py sectors(); 'nearest' is the 5th percentile of non-zero depths in the central band, in mm. Arm swept on servo 6 only, at the named deck/horizon pitches.
sofa_side_2026_09_09.trust: Coverage is the confidence. Readings under ~15% coverage are NOT usable - bearing 470 horizon reads 1.28 m at 3% coverage and means nothing. The high-coverage readings (630/710, 55-78%) are the sofa and are solid.
